__inputs.name: PLATFORM_OPS
__inputs.label: 平台 /ops 完整 HTTPS 地址

title: 运行观测 · 执行影响

panels.title: 所选时段执行影响
panels.description: 按受理时间统计提交，按终态观测时间统计结果。失败率分母为成功加失败。

targets.rawSql: SELECT submissions AS "受理", failed AS "失败", completed AS "成功", cancelled AS "取消", unknown_now AS "期内受理且当前待核实", terminal_time_missing AS "期内受理但缺终态时间", failed_users AS "失败用户", failed_applications AS "失败应用", round(100.0 * failed / nullif(completed + failed, 0), 2) AS "失败率 (%)", statement_timestamp() AS "查询时间" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'total')

panels.title: 受理、失败与取消 · 每五分钟
panels.description: 缩放时间轴可查看对应区间和 Agent 排行。

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, submissions AS "受理", failed AS "失败", cancelled AS "取消" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'trend') ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 执行失败率 · 每五分钟
panels.description: 成功与失败合计为零时比例未知。

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, 100.0 * failed / nullif(completed + failed, 0) AS "失败率 (%)" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'trend') ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 受失败影响的 Agent
panels.description: 点击列头切换排序，点击 Agent 进入对应平台时段。

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent AS "Agent", failed_users AS "失败用户", failed_applications AS "失败应用", failed AS "失败执行" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'agent') WHERE failed > 0 ORDER BY failed_users DESC, failed DESC, agent

panels.title: 首段正文 · 服务端持久事件
panels.description: 当前等待取全部仍在处理且未持久化正文的用户。首段耗时按期内受理执行回看，取消按期内确认时间。浏览器展示、企微送达和 API 客户端接收缺乏统一回执，均为未知。

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel AS "渠道", waiting_users AS "此刻等待用户", round(longest_wait_seconds::numeric,1) AS "当前最长等待 (s)", replied AS "已记录首段样本", round(median_first_output_seconds::numeric,1) AS "首段耗时中位数 (s)", cancelled_before_output AS "首段前取消", round(median_cancel_wait_seconds::numeric,1) AS "取消等待中位数 (s)" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.first_output($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY channel
